summary: Tillster positions itself as "the leading global provider of unified commerce solutions for QSR and fast-casual brands," with a composable platform spanning web/mobile ordering, self-service kiosks, loyalty, couponing, AI-powered recommendations, and dynamic menu management.

Tillster's 2026 Phygital Index Report, published July 24, 2026 and based on a survey of over 2,000 U.S. diners, found 45% of diners say their favorite restaurant chain has changed in the last year (up from 33% in 2025), 61% have abandoned delivery orders due to high service fees, and 71% report being equally or more satisfied ordering via self-service kiosk versus a cashier. (Scope note: This report is industry/consumer-behavior research published by Tillster for thought-leadership purposes, not a claim about Tillster's own customer results.)
